text: Ethics in AI is an important topic today. AI systems can be biased if they learn from unfair data, which may lead to wrong decisions about people. Fairness means treating everyone equally, whatever their background. Privacy is also a big concern, because AI often collects and uses personal information. Companies should be transparent about how their systems work and how they use data. Finally, responsible AI development means building technology that respects human rights and helps society. Governments, developers, and users all have a role to play in making sure AI is safe and fair for everyone.
